title: Ulawulo Lomoya Nelangatye
intro: Khawucinge ngolawulo apho umoya ngokwawo wawuphendula kumlawuli omnye, apho amazwi ezidalwa ezincinci ayenobunzima, nalapho amandla angabonakaliyo emehlweni aqhelekileyo ayegcinwa khona ngenkonzo ecokisekileyo. Lo mfanekiso wazuza ubukumkani obungaqhelekanga kumntu owayemthanda, enegunya phezu kwezinto kunye neejinn. Kodwa igunya elikhulu lafika novavanyo olukhulu - kwaye umzuzu wokugqibela wawuya kutyhila into emangalisayo malunga nohlobo lobomi nokufa ngokwako.
clues: Ndizuze ilifa lobukumkani obukhulu kumzali endimthandayo owayengumprofeti nomkhonzi ka-Allah.
U-Allah undinike igunya phezu komoya, ewuthumela kwimisebenzi yohambo lwenyanga yonke ngentsasa enye.
Nezidalwa ezincinci bezithetha ngendlela endizisebenzisa ngayo, ndize ndime kancinci ukuze ndimangaliswe kukwazi kwazo.
Ndingumlawuli wemikhosi emikhulu yeejinn, abantu, neentaka, zonke zicwangciswe ngolungelelwano phambi kwam.
Umlawuli okude weza kundivavanya ngomngeni onzima, ndaza ndathi itrone yaloo mlawuli iziswe enkundleni yam ngaphambi kokuba undwendwe luphakame nakwisihlalo.
Ndahlala ndimile, ndixhomekeke kwintonga, de kwathi gqi isidalwa esincinci somhlaba sayikrwitsha—kwaza ke kuphela apho abo babendingqongile baqonda ukuba ndidlulile.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Ukuzisa itrone yokumkanikazi okude ngeendlela ezingaphaya kwendalo
Ukujongana nezazi zomntu olawulayo ngemiqondiso emangalisayo
Ukufumana isibhalo sokugqibela esityhiliweyo entabeni engcwele
trial.answer: Ukuzisa itrone yokumkanikazi okude ngeendlela ezingaphaya kwendalo

Umkhukula omkhulu watshabalalisa bonke abantu ababesemkhombeni ngaphandle kwabathembekileyo

outcome.answer: Umlawuli ohloniphekileyo otyeleleyo wamkela ukholo emva kokubona imiqondiso

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. (21:81)
